$comment: T-3.35 mission thresholds, asserted by `pnpm sim-run --scenario mission` (and its three-seed CI job). Six friendly bots play greybox-01 against its committed encounter, paced by the director, at each of `budgets` (the director's human count, overridden for this tool alone), for up to `runSeconds` a seed. A scripted squad leader walks fireteam 1 up the overwatch route and fireteam 2 up the assault route stop by stop (a stop is reached once every member on its feet is within `arriveM`, or `stopSeconds` have passed), then — once the approach is walked — has every bot attack the nearest living enemy within `clearWithinM` of the objective's area and holds it with both only when none is left (B-11, 2026-09-26: walking the squad into the middle of the garrison lost every run), and sends the nearest bot on its feet to revive whoever goes down; the bots fight, take cover and follow the orders on their own. Asserted per budget, on a run of at least `completionMinSeeds` seeds: completion share at least `minCompletion[budget]` (the three-seed CI job reports completion and does not assert it: three runs cannot measure a rate). The completion floors sit just under the baseline measured when this landed (2026-09-23: 30% at one human, 15% at six, over 20 seeds): they catch the squad getting worse, not a target met — bots lose most firefights today (docs/BUGS.md). Over all runs: enemies under fire (suppression at or above `underFireLevel`, or hurt in the last `hurtSeconds`) spend at least `minCoverShare` of that time in a cover point they hold; and at least `minEpisodesPerEngagement` suppression episodes (a squad soldier's suppression rising through `episodeLevel`) per engagement (a stretch of enemy contact). AI cost: `bench.enemies` riflemen and `bench.bots` friendly bots with one human, `bench.seconds` of it; the AI's share of the 33.3 ms tick must stay under `maxAiShare`. 2026-09-26 (B-11): with the leader clearing before it holds, 20 seeds complete 45% at one human and 25% at six (from 0% and 0% with the old walk-in, after B-15); the floors stay where T-3.35 set them. With T-5.06's bots taking cover under fire on attack, move and hold orders: 60% at one human and 20% at six; with the old walk-in leader, still 5% and 0%. 2026-09-26 (T-5.02): the scenario now plays the slice mission — five objectives, about ten minutes — so `runSeconds` is 720, the leader walks the routes into whichever objective clears and holds the compound (joining each route at its nearest stop), and the report gives the median completed length beside the mean. 20 seeds: 70% at one human (median 511 s), 75% at six (median 570 s); enemies under fire in cover 28%. U-001 (2026-09-26): on every run, CI's included, the squad may not go longer than `maxQuietSeconds` without an enemy in contact (one knowing of a squad soldier) while a timed objective runs — contact, not presence: an enemy standing out of sight in its spawn zone is no pressure. Before U-001 the defend stood empty its whole 330 s (355–391 s with the hold before it) in every six-human run. The ceiling allows the compound's intentional quiet hold (60 s once the first counterattack is beaten) and the defend's first wave reaching the squad. With the defend's own counterattack (sent when it starts, stopped when it is won) the defend is a fight, and a squad that comes into it hurt loses it (B-11): 20 seeds complete 50% at one human (median 517 s) and 60% at six (median 494 s); enemies under fire in cover 25%, at its floor — the defend's attackers cross open ground; longest quiet 84 s.
